nd04501acb2.headline: More than 300 infrastructure projects will be implemented in 2021
nd04501acb2.summary: Kazakhstan's Prime Minister announced plans to implement more than 300 infrastructure projects during 2021 as part of the Employment Roadmap.
nd04501acb2.why: Large-scale infrastructure projects can stimulate economic growth, employment, and investment in Kazakhstan.

na2dec7582d.headline: Iran, China sign 25-year cooperation pact
na2dec7582d.summary: Iran and China signed a 25-year strategic cooperation agreement, expanding Beijing's Belt and Road initiative.
na2dec7582d.why: Long-term strategic pacts between major economies like Iran and China can reshape trade, investment, and geopolitical alignments, impacting regional and global economic dynamics.
na2dec7582d.why_moved: The signing of a long-term strategic pact between Iran and China signals increased economic and geopolitical cooperation, potentially affecting regional trade and investment flows.
